transcription_source.ja: 転記の底本は N 提供の Ronat_1980 見開き撮影画像（2026-07-18）。同時提供のもう1点（IMG_6405）は当初「f11 接写」と誤認したが、Cosmopolis 版該当頁（p.422）に N が1914系の異読を朱筆で書き込んだ校合コピーと判明（2026-07-18 訂正）。転記は Ronat 撮影画像のみに拠る。同日 N が原本と照合し、行構成の一点訂正（revision_history 参照）を除き忠実と確認。
transcription_source.en: Transcription rests on N’s photograph of the Ronat_1980 spread (2026-07-18). The second photograph (IMG_6405), first taken for an f11 close-up, is in fact the corresponding Cosmopolis page (p. 422) bearing N’s red-ink collation of 1914-line readings (corrected 2026-07-18). Collated the same day by N against the physical copy; faithful apart from one line-division correction (see revision_history).

result.en: 27 of 28 units match the handscroll divisions; the single divergence is tu_f10_ancestralement_a_n_ouvrir (split in two in 1987; recorded in that unit’s note). The handscroll treats “le vieillard ... avec la probabilité” as one line, corroborating r1.
